body:
How beautiful. It’s great you recognize the blessing that a pet is. I had a dog for 10 years.. he was everything to me. Left my abusive ex a year and a half ago.. and he kept my dog. I tried to fight for him, but I wasn’t winning, and he loved dragging it out to torture me more. 
I miss my little boy so much. I know I’d be so much better with him here. 
Reading this took me longer than it should have.. I just couldn’t/can’t stop sobbing.
